metadata.description: Leanfare for Claude Code and Cowork: Claude hands reading, drafting and checks to cheaper or free models you pick, so your plan lasts longer.

plugins.name: leanfare
plugins.description: Hands reading, drafting and checks to cheaper models you pick, so your Claude plan lasts longer. Needs the free Leanfare app on your computer.

plugins.name: leanfare-level
plugins.description: Leanfare in every Cowork and Claude Desktop chat: a row above the message box to pick its level, speed, quality and models, or turn it off, with no questions; the level in the system prompt, read from Leanfare's tool list; at levels 4 and 5 a reminder to plan first. Needs Leanfare connected.
